description: Regression test: a pending TypeLookup request whose type server is removed must be failed, and
the endpoints queued behind it re-requested from their own type server.
The first publisher starves its builtin flow controller, so it announces TypeBig but can never send
the TypeLookup reply, and its announcements stop once the budget is spent, so the subscriber
deletes its participant after 10 seconds, before the subscriber can know the type, so it never
matches and the subscriber detects it as gone. The second publisher
announces the same TypeBig later, and is queued behind the pending request without a new request
The subscriber sets a request timeout far longer than its own window, so only the removal of the
first publisher can resolve TypeBig and let the subscriber match the second publisher.
Before the fix the subscriber never discovers the second publisher's writer and times out.
